<!-- Generated by scripts/dsl-reference.mjs from schema/, test/fixtures/public-surface.json and site/reference-notes/. Do not edit by hand. -->

The look, the shell, the footer and the density of the App, and what each tenant may brand. Every key here is stable ([status](/docs/status/)). [All parts](/docs/app-dsl/).

```ts
ui: {
  logo: 'buildings',
  shell: { placement: 'side', width: 'wide' },
  theme: { preset: 'sage' },
  editing: { save: 'blur' },
  locale: 'en-US', timezone: 'America/New_York',
  footer: { text: 'Prices exclude tax.', links: [{ label: 'Terms', href: 'https://example.com/terms' }] },
},
```

`logo` is an App icon, never an image URL. `theme.preset` is one of the
built-in looks (`workshop` by default, `lumen`, `mono`, `sage`, `ledger`) or one registered with
`defineTheme`; `accent`, `radius` and `font`
adjust it. `currency` is US dollars unless the App says otherwise, and a money
rule names its own only for a column in another. See [Looks](/docs/looks/)
and [Navigation and shell](/docs/nav-and-shell/).

`timezone` may instead be read per reader: `timezone: { column:
'desk_setting.timezone', default: 'America/New_York' }` counts each reader's
today and windows in the zone the first row of that column they may read
names — their tenant's, their account's. Writes keep `default`.

`locale` is also the App's own language, the one its `messages/` catalogs are
written from, and may be read per reader the same way: `locale: { column:
'person.locale', default: 'en-US' }`. A tenant's tag (`branding.allow:
['locale']`) comes before `default`. `messages: fromRecord('tenant_message',
{ by: 'tenant', tenantField, fields: { key, locale, text } })` keeps a
tenant's own words over the catalogs. See [Languages](/docs/languages/).

## `branding`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding` | object | Stable | What each tenant may change about how the App looks to its people, and which tenant roles may save it. Never the grounds, the ink or the recipes. A tenant App only. |

## `branding.allow`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.allow` | array | Stable | What each tenant may set. preset (which of themes it starts from) needs more than one of themes; locale is the tenant's language, under each person's own. |

## `branding.editors`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.editors` | array | Stable | The tenant roles whose members may save it: a tenant's admins. |

## `branding.themes`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes` | array | Stable | The themes a tenant starts from (defineTheme results or built-in names); the first is the default. Absent: the App's own look. |

## `branding.themes[][kind=theme].contract`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes[][kind=theme].contract` |  | Stable | The theme contract a published look was written to. A theme written to another is refused, naming the release to install. One of `1`. |

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes[][kind=theme].density` | `"compact"` · `"comfortable"` · `"spacious"` | Stable |  One of `comfortable`, `compact`, `spacious`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |

## `branding.themes[][kind=theme].extends`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes[][kind=theme].extends` | object | Stable | Start from a built-in look, or from a theme, and say only what differs. Without it, colors names ground, surface, ink and accent in both modes and the rest is derived. One of `ledger`, `lumen`, `mono`, `sage`, `workshop`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes[][kind=theme].extends[kind=theme].kind` |  | Stable |  One of `theme`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |

## `branding.themes[][kind=theme].motion`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes[][kind=theme].motion` | `"house"` · `"brisk"` · `"still"` | Stable | How fast things enter: house (omitted) as the platform moves, brisk a quarter quicker, still with nothing entering, as reduced motion draws it. A reader who asks for reduced motion gets still under every pace. One of `brisk`, `house`, `still`. |

## `branding.themes[][kind=theme].palettes`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `branding.themes[][kind=theme].palettes` | array | Stable | Named color variations over the theme's own colors. IDs must be unique within the theme, checked by the App parser. |

## `ui.theme`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui.theme` | object | Stable | The App's look: a built-in or one of customThemes by name ({ preset }), with the App's accent, or one read from a record (fromRecord). Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.accent` | string \| object | Stable | The App's own color: one, authored for the light ground and mixed toward white on the dark one, or { light, dark }, one for each, worn as written. The soft tint of a selected item derives from it. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.accent.dark` | string | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.accent.light` | string | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.font` | string | Stable | A CSS font stack for the data face. Code surfaces keep the code face. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.for` | object | Stable | A theme per audience: public for every page a signed-out visitor sees, worn whatever a reader picked; and one per role, the first entry in written order the account holds, over a tenant's saved theme. A reader's own pick still wins in the shell. Each names a built-in or one of customThemes; each role is one of auth.roles. |
| `ui.theme.for.public` | string | Stable |  Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.for.roles` | object | Stable |  |
| `ui.theme.palette` | string | Stable | A palette of the selected preset, or default for its original colors. Requires preset; references are checked by the App parser. |
| `ui.theme.preset` | string | Stable | A built-in theme, or one of customThemes, used by the Default preference. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `ui.theme.radius` | string | Stable | A CSS length: "0", "10px". Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |

## `ui.timezone`

| Key | Type | Status | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ui.timezone` | string \| object | Stable | IANA zone the app’s "today" is reckoned in ("Australia/Sydney"). Absent: the server’s clock. A TIMESTAMP or DATETIME that carries no zone holds the wall clock in this zone (UTC when the App names none) — whatever writes it: an action's now, a machine's since, a Date a command writes, a New form's now. A column with a zone (timestamptz) holds the instant. { column, default } counts each reader's days in the zone the first row of that text column they may read names (their tenant's, their account's); writes keep default. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `ui.timezone.column` | string | Stable | The resource's text column naming the reader's IANA zone: "desk_setting.timezone". Used in `examples/apps/lintel/app.ts`. |
| `ui.timezone.default` | string | Stable | The App's own zone: what writes keep, and the reader's where the row names none. |

One of `large`, `plain`, `round`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/resources.ts`. |

One of `gradient`, `plain`, `tint`. |
| `theme.recipes.bar` | `"plain"` · `"ruled"` · `"dark"` · `"airy"` · `"soft"` | Stable | `plain`: The top bar is the menu’s ground with a hairline under it. `ruled`: The top bar ends in a 2px rule instead of a hairline, and casts no shadow. `dark`: The top bar takes the menu’s ground and inks, so a dark or brand-colored menu runs across the top too. `airy`: The top bar is taller, with a large bold brand name and a wide, raised search box. `soft`: The top bar is a panel in the surface color with a hairline under it, apart from the menu beside it. One of `airy`, `dark`, `plain`, `ruled`, `soft`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/blueprint.ts`. |
| `theme.recipes.board` | `"ruled"` · `"soft"` · `"strip"` | Stable | `ruled`: A board’s lanes are outlined by a hairline; its cards lie flat on them. `soft`: As ruled, but each card casts the look’s card shadow: only the cards lift. `strip`: Each lane is headed by a strip tinted with its tone, its cards white on the lane. One of `ruled`, `soft`, `strip`. Used in `examples/apps/lintel/views.ts`. |
| `theme.recipes.buttons` | `"accent"` · `"raised"` · `"keyed"` | Stable | `accent`: The primary button is filled in the accent; the rest are quiet. `raised`: Secondary buttons are white keys with a hairline and a small shadow, raised off the page. `keyed`: Buttons are hard-edged keys: the primary one filled in the accent with an ink edge, like a hazard tag, the rest edged in the ink.
